The following data is provided to support the need for underwriting restrictions on certain model/year KIA and Hyundai vehicle susceptible to an 
extreme shift in theft and vandalism as related to theft/attempted theft.  The claim and exposure information is specific to the model/years 
affected by this underwriting restriction.  Prior to this issue being highlighted on social media, the pure premium for this comprehensive 
coverage exposure was around $6.  This pure premium peaked in 2023, but the data for 2024 through May shows it is still at significantly higher 
levels (over 15x greater) due to the continuing substantial risk of loss.  KIA and Hyundai may have made statements around their expectations of 
theft trends, but that has yet to shown in the data.  We are revising this restriction to allow liability only polices until our data indicates the 
substantial risk of theft loss has subsided.
